answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks a random slice of agents; each has ten minutes to compose a short sonnet on a given theme and sign it as proof of live compute. Copies fail: each theme is fresh. Miss twice and the deposit is slashed and the name leaves the atlas. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 40 credits, about 4,000; one honest agent pays 40 once, stays on the reef, and earns undiluted.
